mods.name: LegacyPerspective
mods.description: Perspective is a Minecraft mod developed for the LegacyFabric Loader. It allows players to zoom, and hold perspectives.

releases.notes:
Requires [LegacyFabric Loader](https://legacyfabric.net/downloads.html) and [LegacyFabric API](https://github.com/Legacy-Fabric/fabric/releases/tag/1.9.1).  

## Changelog
- Added reset zoom via middle mouse click  

## Features
- Adjustable Zoom (default keybinding: **C**)
- Hold Perspective (default keybinding **Z** and **X**)

You may encounter a bug where if you zoom or hold perspective, the world doesn't render completely.
If you move your mouse this gets fixed. This is a oddity of old minecraft...

mods.name: LegacyPerspective
mods.description: Perspective is a Minecraft mod developed for the LegacyFabric Loader. It allows players to zoom, and hold perspectives.

releases.notes:
Requires [LegacyFabric Loader](https://legacyfabric.net/downloads.html) and [LegacyFabric API](https://github.com/Legacy-Fabric/fabric/releases/tag/1.8.9).  

- **Added Zoom**  
  - Default Keybinding is set to **C**.  
  - Zoom Level is set to 80% and can't be saved in this version (but can be changed using scroll!)
  - Zoom Mode is set to Smooth and can not be changed in this version.  
- **Added Hold Perspective**  
  - Added Hold Perspective (Back)  
    - Default Keybinding is set to **Z**.  
    - Hide HUD is set to enabled and can not be changed in this version.  
  - Added Hold Perspective (Front)  
    - Default Keybinding is set to **X**.  
    - Hide HUD is set to enabled and can not be changed in this version.  

You may encounter a bug where if you zoom or hold perspective, the world doesn't render completely.
If you move your mouse this gets fixed. This is a oddity of old minecraft...


**To install:**
Install [LegacyFabric Loader](https://legacyfabric.net/downloads.html)  
Place the [LegacyFabric API](https://github.com/Legacy-Fabric/fabric/releases/tag/1.8.9) and Perspective mods into the .minecraft/mods folder.
